name: api-uptime-monitor
description: Serverless API uptime monitoring service built with AWS Lambda

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd infrastructure && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd infrastructure && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.test:all: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.local:start: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.type-check: cd backend && npm run type-check && cd ../frontend && npm run type-check

author: Francisco Perez
